verses.en: Ha Mim
verses.ar: حمٓ

verses.en: By the Scripture that makes things clear,
verses.ar: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ

verses.en: truly We sent it down on a blessed night––We have always sent warnings––
verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ

verses.en: a night when every matter of wisdom was made distinct
verses.ar: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ

verses.en: at Our command––We have always sent messages to man––
verses.ar: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ

verses.en: as a mercy [Prophet] from your Lord who sees and knows all,
verses.ar: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

verses.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything between––if only you people were firm believers––
verses.ar: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

verses.en: there is no god but Him: He gives life and death––He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers––
verses.ar: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

verses.en: yet in [their state of] doubt they take nothing seriously.
verses.ar: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ

verses.en: [Prophet], watch out for the Day when the sky brings forth clouds of smoke for all to see.
verses.ar: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

verses.en: It will envelop the people. They will cry, ‘This is a terrible torment!
verses.ar: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

verses.en: Lord relieve us from this torment! We believe!’
verses.ar: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.en: How will this [sudden] faith benefit them? When a prophet came to warn them plainly,
verses.ar: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ

verses.en: they turned their backs on him, saying, ‘He is tutored! He is possessed!’
verses.ar: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ

verses.en: We shall hold the torment back for a while ––you are sure to return [to Us]––
verses.ar: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ

verses.en: and on the Day We seize [them] mightily We shall exact retribution.
verses.ar: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ

verses.en: We tested the people of Pharaoh before them: a noble messenger was sent to them,
verses.ar: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ

verses.en: saying, ‘Hand the servants of God over to me! I am a faithful messenger who has been sent to you.
verses.ar: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

verses.en: Do not consider yourselves to be above God! I come to you with clear authority.
verses.ar: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

verses.en: I seek refuge in my Lord and yours against your insults!
verses.ar: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ

verses.en: If you do not believe me, just let me be.’
verses.ar: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ

verses.en: [Moses] cried to his Lord, ‘These people are evildoers!’
verses.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ

verses.en: [God replied], ‘Escape in the night with My servants, for you are sure to be pursued.
verses.ar: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

verses.en: Leave the sea behind you parted and their army will be drowned.’
verses.ar: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ

verses.en: Many a garden and spring they left behind,
verses.ar: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

verses.en: many a cornfield and noble building,
verses.ar: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ

verses.en: many a thing in which they had delighted:
verses.ar: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ

verses.en: We gave these to another people to inherit.
verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ

verses.en: Neither heavens nor earth shed a tear for them, nor were they given any time.
verses.ar: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ

verses.en: We saved the Children of Israel from their degrading suffering
verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ

verses.en: at the hands of Pharaoh: he was a tyrant who exceeded all bounds.
verses.ar: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ

verses.en: We chose them knowingly above others:
verses.ar: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.en: We gave them revelations in which there was a clear test.
verses.ar: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ

verses.en: These people here assert,
verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ

verses.en: ‘There is nothing beyond our one death: we will not be resurrected.
verses.ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ

verses.en: Bring back our forefathers, if what you say is true.’
verses.ar: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

verses.en: Are they better than the people of Tubba and those who flourished before them? We destroyed them all- they were guilty.
verses.ar: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ

verses.en: We were not playing a pointless game when We created the heavens and earth and everything in between;
verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ

verses.en: We created them for a true purpose, but most people do not comprehend.
verses.ar: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verses.en: The Day of Decision is the time appointed for all;
verses.ar: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

verses.en: a Day when no friend can take another’s place.
verses.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

verses.en: No one will receive any help except for those to whom God shows mercy: He is the Mighty, the Merciful Lord.
verses.ar: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

verses.en: The tree of Zaqqum
verses.ar: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

verses.en: will be food for the sinners:
verses.ar: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ

verses.en: [hot] as molten metal, it boils in their bellies
verses.ar: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ

verses.en: like seething water.
verses.ar: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

verses.en: ‘Take him! Thrust him into the depths of Hell!
verses.ar: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

verses.en: Pour scalding water over his head as punishment!’
verses.ar: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

verses.en: ‘Taste this, you powerful, respected man!
verses.ar: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ

verses.en: This is what you doubted.’
verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ

verses.en: But those mindful of God will be in a safe place
verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ

verses.en: amid Gardens and springs,
verses.ar: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

verses.en: clothed in silk and fine brocade, facing one another:
verses.ar: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ

verses.en: so it will be. We shall wed them to maidens with large, dark eyes.
verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ

verses.en: Secure and contented, they will call for every kind of fruit.
verses.ar: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ

verses.en: After the one death they will taste death no more. God will guard them from the torment of Hell,
verses.ar: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

verses.en: a bounty from your Lord. That is the supreme triumph.
verses.ar: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

verses.en: We have made this Quran easy to understand- in your own language [Prophet]- so that they may take heed.
verses.ar: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.en: So wait; the disbelievers too are waiting.
verses.ar: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
